notes.title: VOIDBORN 1.0 OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
After 18 months of early access, Voidborn has finally reached 1.0!

This update completes the full run of the game, including all main areas and bosses, and aims to set a polished and consistent quality standard all the way from the main menu to the end credits.

Thank you so much to everyone who has supported Voidborn during it's Early Access period. As a solo developer on this game, creating it has been very tough at times, but mostly a lot of fun. I am very proud of what I have been able to achieve with this game, and I hope you will enjoy playing it as much as I enjoyed developing it.

[h2]Voidborn 1.0 Trailer[/h2]
[previewyoutube=czvjEIzga8g;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42678423/d9a38d6b9ed492ce83467c713ba72a5c288b4c55.png[/img]


[h2]Ascend The Black Castle[/h2]
The final location of the game blends together interior- and exterior levels of the castle in a pseudo-randomized order with seamless level transitions, all in the pursuit of creating an exciting climax to the voidborn's quest, and putting all the player's skills to the test.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42678423/3b8587f44bffed72fab6eedc26f748ba12fa9b2c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42678423/badfd6ceae8a63949245b459f9f7db07e12b1a10.png[/img]


[h2]New introduction levels[/h2]
Blending into the Dungeons of Decay map pool, these levels act as a new introduction to the game, and do a much better job of getting the player familiar with the fundamental gameplay mechanics. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42678423/8b00e7339c39628023bd3d9d6999eb843af9a384.png[/img]


[h2]Controller support[/h2]
Voidborn now features full controller support for Xbox controllers. This was a feature that was promised much sooner than delivered on, and I apologize for that. The reason being is that I simply underestimated just how extensive of a feature this was to implement, especially since the UI was not designed to be able to be used with a controller which meant I had to make a few compromises in the implementation.

Voidborn should be fully playable now on Steamdeck, but I don't have one myself to test it on so I can't confirm, and it has not been officially verified by Steam, but I am working on that.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42678423/34e7446bf692e41b329ff4974cea73820b174edb.png[/img]


[h2]Trials of the Scarlet Curse[/h2]
All difficulty modifiers for Trials of the Scarlet Curse have been added.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42678423/a83c5006256e98290d4b8ea3e57c908d575a0044.png[/img]


[h2]New weapon aspects[/h2]
There are now 8 total weapon aspects, two for each weapon. I wanted each weapon to have three aspects, but unfortunately the ones that I had planned to add ended up being too ambitious to finish in time for this update. So maybe in the future?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42678423/fe89c0d235d5931afb55d201b3a141731f27e642.png[/img]


[h2]Steam Achievements[/h2]
Voidborn now has 24 Steam Achievements in ranging difficulty.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42678423/238482056fc5974516d9320debfa4006654438a2.png[/img]

[h2]New music[/h2]
[h5]Dungeons of Decay[/h5]
The soundtrack for Dungeons of Decay was made by me over 3 years ago, and quite frankly, it does not hold up. So, this soundtrack has been replaced with a new banger created by Crisp.

[h5]The Black Castle[/h5]
The final location in the game features two new music tracks also created by Crisp.

Go check out his other music: https://soundcloud.com/stillcrisp



[h2]New Amulets[/h2]
These amulets can either be found or unlocked through Trials of the Scarlet Curse.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42678423/55c8576fa8e964acefe686b8af36de84774f1b51.png[/img]

[h2]New item icons[/h2]
All items in the game now have a unique illustration displayed in the inventory.

All illustrations for the game have been made by Huhrizon: https://www.instagram.com/huhrizon/


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42678423/545eb32ffa54c1fa607123491ef48293394dc954.png[/img]



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42678423/0a5c9b6be0b4c5af9610751f513d0d8492ba0ee6.png[/img]

Many changes, improvements, and bug fixes have been made throughout the whole game. These are some of the major ones, please view the full patch notes at the bottom of this post for the complete list of changes.


[h2]The Shadowed City main gate[/h2]
The main gate to The Shadowed City can now be opened to provide a shortcut. The lever to open the gate can be found somewhere inside the citadel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42678423/b387b0ef71537a88f67ca1e3f4a55a4a20406372.png[/img]


[h2]Ultimate rework[/h2]
The Ultimate has been reworked. Instead of slowly charging up over time, the player must now charge it by dealing damage to enemies. When the Ultimate is not being charged, its charge will slowly drain over time. This change has been made to promote more aggressive gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42678423/68574bf822d56b2f09c438dcd8cc4616645d1c1d.png[/img]


[h2]Improved levels[/h2]
All levels in the game have received lighting and texture improvements to look, play- and perform better. This includes higher quality baked lighting, adjustments made to lighting to make the game easier on the eyes and improve visual clarity, and general performance improvements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42678423/4dda9f9535a60c1a61627193de4501c9308e0e8e.png[/img]


[h2]Balancing[/h2]
Because this version now features the complete run, I have basically had to rebalance the entire game. This includes tweaking number of enemy encounters per location, enemy spawns, enemy damage, enemy health, weapon damage, balancing powerps, adjusting weapon unlock- and upgrade prices, etc. This has been a very tricky task but hopefully I've done a decent job, regardless I will continue to balance the game based on player feedback.

For full list of balancing changes please view the full patch notes at the bottom of this post.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42678423/6b547217f5001b68bc9beb895cde0c9c448a48a5.png[/img]


A lot of the work that went into this update was making the game consistent throughout the entirety of it by bringing all of the gameplay systems to a standard that feels complete, both in terms of how the game plays, and how it affects me working with the game. This means going forward, making any changes or adding new content should be much easier to implement.

However, going forward my main focus will shift from Voidborn to a new project that I have been developing on the side since late 2023. But Voidborn will still continue to receive quality of life updates.
There are still more things that I want to add to the game in the future, but I cannot make any promises on when or even if that will happen as my next game will likely take up all of my game dev time.

But as it is now, I view 1.0 as the complete Voidborn experience, which is much bigger than I had first envisioned when I began developing the game in late 2021, and that is large thanks to those who have supported the game since before it was even released, and throughout Early Access, so once again big thanks to everyone who has supported Voidborn.

My new game will be announced very soon, so to stay updated please follow my socials :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42678423/6e53bbc447b99ad58303bde79d0c3c09cc13e3f1.png[/img]

notes.title: Voidborn 1.0 Release Date Announcement!
notes.notes:
[h3]Note: The release date has been pushed from April 4th to April 7th[/h3]

I am excited to announce that after 18 months of Early Access, Voidborn will finally be launching into 1.0 on [b]April 7th[/b]!

This update will complete the full run of the game with the final area, along with many other additions, changes, and improvements throughout the entire game.

[h2]1.0 Announcement Trailer[/h2]
[previewyoutube=bvEKo4FBegI;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Prepare yourself to ascend The Black Castle[/h2]
[i]The final area of the game, atop which the final demigod awaits you...[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42678423/495979859eb74557850bda741cb731e67985d89d.png[/img]

[h2]In preparation for 1.0 release[/h2]

[h4]Launch discount[/h4]
1.0 will launch with a 20% discount. If you planned to pick up the game, I would advice to hold off until the release.

[h4]Pricing changes[/h4]
After the launch sale is over, you can expect Voidborn to increase in price by around 15% depending on your currency. These pricing changes will also include new prices for the regions Latin America and Middle East / North Africa.

[h4]Demo[/h4]
After the update the demo will no longer be available to download from Steam. But if you already have it installed you can still continue to play it as it is DRM-free, as is the full game!

[h5]
Wishlist Voidborn to get notified on release! I hope to see you all there :)[/h5]

notes.title: What's next?
notes.notes:
First of all, thank you everyone who has supported Early Access so far! The game has already done way better than I expected, which makes me even more excited to bring more content to the game.

Now, what to expect from the upcoming content updates.

[h3][u][b]Possible spoilers ahead[/b][/u][/h3]

The first content update is already in development and is expected to be finished by the end of next month! Here are some of the major the things it will include.


[h2]Sacred Grove[/h2]
A new shortcut level that connects the start of of [i]Bloodrain Valley[/i] to Vincent's sanctuary, with a bigger focus on platforming.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42678423/d3c47b5c8ed1fd53b442bb4334a29ece2a1a6c4c.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42678423/6674ef63c4e384169bd72fb6e6b1b22c318fe6c1.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42678423/036bd0e153d421c74791f26fa9c5747041a264ca.gif[/img]

[h2]Void Offering[/h2]
A new type of Offering that will bring new upgrades to all weapons in the game, as well as character upgrades. This offering type will have a focus on piercing logic, along with some other interesting stuff.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42678423/a97495f84c99f02bb2ca03d62522a61a1450c960.gif[/img]

[h3]Additionally,[/h3] the update will have reworked melee. [i]The Regal Blade[/i] will be getting both [i]Chaos[/i] and [i]Lightning[/i] upgrades, and hopefully the game will get controller support.
Along with other fixes, improvements and balancing changes.

I hope you are looking forward to this update which is coming soon before...

[h2]Content Update II[/h2]
A larger update, featuring the next main area of the game after [i]The Shadowed City[/i].
Expected to release some time this winter.

[h3]That is all for now. See you around, Voidborn.[/h3]

notes.title: VOIDBORN DEMO UPDATE 1
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=nTUwD6NjS4E;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]What's new?[/b]
[list]
[*] Three new power-ups, two of which are alternative fire modes for the rifle and shotgun, and one Void Dash power-up.
[*] Improved levels with much higher detail and better lighting.
[*] Reworked "Big Orange Ball" boss battle, now known as "Left Eye of the Crimson Void".
[*] Boss levels now have a small peaceful room before the battle with a Void Fountain and a health potion, restoring up to 25 health.
[*] Reworked dash system, you can now properly dash on inclined surfaces.
[*] Added directional sliding, you can now slide in all 8 movement directions.
[*] Sliding now takes the players movement velocity and kinetic energy into account.
[*] Improved visual clarity. Chasing enemies now have a different color from casters, dead enemies stop glowing, fireballs have a slighlty different color making them more distinguishable from lava and torches.
[*] Added custom key binds in settings.
[*] Added weapon swapping with scroll wheel (can be disabled in settings).
[*] Added cooldown displays on the HUD for abilities.
[*] Made it more clear when you picked up Essence.
[*] Hitting the fireball with the revolver now creates a more powerful explosion.
[/list]
[b]Other noteworthy fixes and improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved performance.
[*] Improved wall-jumping/sliding accuracy.
[*] Fixed certain enemy attacks and particle effects being tied to the framerate.
[*] Nerfed Decay Demon's laser attack and overall damage.
[*] Decreased enemy spawns in certain levels.
[*] Decreased costs of Void Fountain upgrades.
[*] Increased pick up range of Essence.
[*] Increased melee damage.
[*] Bosses take increased damage from explosions and lightning attacks.
[*] Falling off the bridge in Bloodrain Valley now teleports you back.
[*] Slightly decreased the revolvers rate of fire.
[*] Increased spawn rate of blue torch pillars.
[*] Increased Void Dash impact range.
[/list]
